svg.title: Flow at five valve openings, two supplies
svg.desc: The stem is held at 70, 75, 80, 85 and again 75 percent for 30 seconds each. With 100 kilopascals regulated across the valve the flow is 1.400, 1.500, 1.600 and 1.700 kilograms per second. With the fixed supply the pressure across the valve rises to 102.9 kilopascals at 70 percent and falls to 94.1 kilopascals at 85 percent, so the flow is 1.421 and 1.650 kilograms per second there. The second visit to 75 percent repeats the first.
svg.text: Flow at five valve openings, two supplies
